title_en: Guiding Case No. 241: Huang v. Pingguo County Public Security Bureau, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region — compensation for injuries caused by illegal use of weapons
ruling_gist_en: Where a compensation claimant has already obtained state compensation for physical injury causing disability due to the illegal use of weapons by a functionary of a state organ, but after the statutory payment period for disability compensation, etc., expires, there continue to be necessary expenses such as nursing fees and expenses for assistive devices for disabled persons, and the compensation claimant files a new compensation claim for such expenses, the people's court shall support it according to law.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 241

Huang v. Pingguo County Public Security Bureau, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region — compensation for injuries caused by illegal use of weapons

(Discussed and adopted by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 23, 2024)

Keywords
State compensation / compensation for injuries caused by illegal use of weapons / compensation for personal injury / payment period

Ruling Gist
Where a compensation claimant has already received state compensation for bodily injury and disability caused by illegal use of weapons by state agency personnel, but after the payment period or term of disability compensation expires, necessary expenses such as nursing fees and expenses for assistive devices for disabled living continue to arise, and the compensation claimant files a new state compensation claim for such expenses, the people's court shall support it according to law.

Basic Facts
In August 1997, during the investigation of a criminal case, police officers of the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, illegally used weapons and accidentally shot Huang (a non-involved person), causing permanent disability, which was appraised as Grade 1 disability. On September 14, 1998, the Compensation Committee of the Baise Intermediate People's Court, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, issued Compensation Decision (1998) Bai Zhong Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 4, ordering the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau to compensate Huang for medical expenses, hospitalization expenses, lost wages, and other costs up to September 14, 1998, in the amount of RMB 98,230.63, and disability compensation of RMB 201,722.4, totaling RMB 299,953.03. After the decision took effect, the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau fully performed its obligations.

In 2018, Huang again applied for state compensation, requesting the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau to pay disability compensation, nursing fees, assistive device expenses, and other costs totaling over RMB 1.5 million. On June 15, 2018, the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau issued Notification of Non-Acceptance of State Compensation Application (Ping Gong Pei Bu Shou Zi [2018] No. 001), deciding not to accept the application. Compensation claimant Huang applied for reconsideration to the Baise City Public Security Bureau on July 9, 2018. On July 16, 2018, the Baise City Public Security Bureau issued Criminal Reconsideration Decision (Bai Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2018] No. 001), affirming the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau's decision of non-acceptance. Dissatisfied, compensation claimant Huang applied on August 13, 2018, to the Compensation Committee of the Baise Intermediate People's Court, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, for a state compensation decision.

Judgment
On November 13, 2018, the Compensation Committee of the Baise Intermediate People's Court, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, issued State Compensation Decision (2018) Gui 10 Wei Pei No. 5: 1. Revoked the Notification of Non-Acceptance of State Compensation Application (Ping Gong Pei Bu Shou Zi [2018] No. 001) of the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau and the Criminal Reconsideration Decision (Bai Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2018] No. 001) of the Baise City Public Security Bureau; 2. The Pingguo County Public Security Bureau shall continue to pay compensation claimant Huang nursing fees, expenses for assistive devices for disabled living, and other costs totaling RMB 497,277; 3. Dismissed Huang's other state compensation claims. Both the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau and Huang were dissatisfied and filed appeals respectively to the Compensation Committee of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court. The Compensation Committee of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region High People's Court issued Notices (2020) Gui Wei Pei Jian No. 2 and (2020) Gui Wei Pei Jian No. 5, dismissing the appeals of both the Pingguo County Public Security Bureau and Huang.

Reasoning
Article 34, Paragraph 1, Item 2 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where partial or total loss of the ability to work is caused, medical expenses, nursing fees, expenses for assistive devices for disabled living, rehabilitation fees, and other necessary expenses incurred due to the disability and expenses necessary for continued treatment, as well as disability compensation, shall be paid. Disability compensation shall be determined according to the degree of loss of the ability to work and in accordance with the disability grade prescribed by the state, and shall not exceed twenty times the average annual wage of employees in the previous year of the state. Where total loss of the ability to work is caused, living expenses shall also be paid to any person without the ability to work whom the injured person supports." In this case, given that Huang had already received the maximum disability compensation of RMB 201,722.4, equivalent to twenty times the average annual wage of employees in the previous year of the state, in 1998, his application for disability compensation again based on the same injury facts has no legal basis.

Although more than 20 years have passed since the incident, the harmful consequences caused by the illegal use of weapons to Huang are still ongoing. According to Huang's disability grade, age, and health condition, the losses will continue and expand, constituting newly incurred damages. Huang's claim for compensation for the newly incurred damages arising from the same illegal facts, i.e., compensation for newly increased nursing fees, expenses for assistive devices for disabled living, and other costs, does not constitute duplicate compensation. Pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24) — "The nursing period shall be calculated up to the date when the citizen recovers the ability to take care of himself or herself. Where a citizen is unable to recover the ability to take care of himself or herself due to disability, a reasonable nursing period may be determined based on factors such as age and health condition, generally not exceeding twenty years" — and Article 15, Paragraph 1 — "Compensation for expenses for assistive devices for disabled living shall be calculated according to the reasonable cost standard of commonly applicable devices. Where the injury has special needs, the opinion of the assistive device fitting institution may be referenced" — Huang's disability is Grade 1, and he is unable to recover the ability to take care of himself. Referencing the 2017 Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Road Traffic Accident Damage Compensation Calculation Standards for the average annual wage of employees in urban units in the resident services, repair, and other service industries, the nursing fee compensation is determined as RMB 475,110 (RMB 47,511 × 10 years = RMB 475,110). Huang applied for continued payment of expenses for assistive devices for disabled living and other costs totaling RMB 22,167. Such expenses indeed exist and are necessary and reasonable, and are therefore supported according to law.

Relevant Laws
Article 34 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China
Articles 14 and 15 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24)
